cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that letter under my plate. Remember how I taught you to get through breakfast without an argument? We only just started eating together again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother cancelled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're checking the rent. I've covered it. Next lesson: finish your toast before opening things that upset you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let me open it after breakfast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After we've cleared up together. You finally unpacked yesterday; I can't teach you how to have a peaceful morning if you're packing again.

reason: Replace the removable teaching prefaces with pupil corrections that directly change how A pursues the exact Drive. Preserve the specific partner contribution and make the ending answer it.
